title: Market data: live crypto, daily USD/ILS, server function for stock prices
changes: Provider layer (scripts/src/97-market-data.js): one interface over several sources; the portfolio engine does not change when a provider changes
Crypto prices from Coinbase (live spot, no key); USD/ILS from the ECB reference rate via Frankfurter (daily, no key), labelled ECB so it is not mistaken for the Bank of Israel representative rate

Stocks and ETFs through the site's own function /api/market (netlify/functions/market.mjs) with a Twelve Data adapter; the key is read only from the TWELVEDATA_API_KEY environment variable; symbols are validated, quotes cached for 60 seconds, Tel Aviv prices converted from agorot
Holdings: price status bar with last refresh, sources and a refresh button; every price shows its source and time, old prices are marked stale; a failed provider keeps the last price and says so
Refresh timing: crypto 5 min, stocks 15 min, dollar 6 h; automatic when the investments area opens (at most once a minute); identical requests share one call
Manual prices stay as a fallback until a provider answers
docs/investments/MARKET_DATA.md: provider comparison from official pages, the choice, and setup steps
npm test now also runs .mjs tests
